name: NJ-05
label: Safe D

District leans Democratic with an incumbent running
model.rationale: Gottheimer holds an overwhelming cash edge and both prediction markets price his reelection around 96-97%, while the district's modest Democratic lean and incumbency favor him. With no polls or expert ratings available, the fundamentals-based estimate of a high-teens margin stands essentially unchanged.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Gottheimer would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Josh Gottheimer seeks another term in a northern New Jersey district that leans slightly Democratic. He enters the general election with a dominant financial position, having raised about $4.8 million and holding nearly $12.8 million on hand, while Republican Sean Kirrane has raised only about $56,000 with minimal outside support. No independent candidate is seen as a factor.

With no public general-election polling and no expert ratings, the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing. Prediction markets put Gottheimer's chances around 96-97 percent, consistent with a comfortable double-digit expected margin. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of direct polling rather than any specific sign of vulnerability.
